build_parser_class: build a Parser class that manages multiple argparse sub-parsers in an ordered dictionary
create_add_parser: create a method to register a named argparse sub-parser into the Parser instance
run_parse_args: run the parse method to iterate over registered parsers and extract known args from sys.argv
test_parse_known_args: test the parse method to ensure it splits sys.argv across multiple sub-parsers correctly
review_parser_log: review the Parser class log method that prints all registered arg_parsers for debugging
